subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw make project trees plus split/fanout/seed thread triage a first-class Control UI/Gateway feature, and what transcript semantics should it use?
rationale: The remaining work changes user-facing session organization, Gateway protocol shape, and persisted transcript/session-state meaning, so automation cannot safely choose the product model.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Control UI thread-triage tracker and require a maintainer-sponsored design before any implementation PR.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move project-tree ownership to the open Projects issue and open narrower issues for composer fanout and selected-message split/copy semantics.

options.title: Close Into Projects Only
options.body: Close this as superseded by the open Projects tracker, accepting that split/move/fanout and seed workflows are no longer independently tracked.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Control UI thread-triage tracker and require a maintainer-sponsored design before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing owner from the recent Control UI/session management history and prior review context.
